toolArguments.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: actual 2D side-view brawler character animation sheet, transparent RGBA, one horizontal row of exactly SIX distinct full-body poses.
Primary request: Generate Mac Modem from the supplied canonical references as a slim, wiry man, never a bulky muscular action hero. This is a game sprite sheet, NOT a character poster or scene.
Input images: 1 exact canonical facial identity/paint; 2 canonical red outfit and slim body proportions; 3 corroborating thin body and two narrow braids; 4 polished detailed comic-ink style only, not its camera angle.
Identity: ginger beard and moustache; precisely two thin long ginger braids; black cap and black tee with the small red MODEM clothing mark; open burgundy sleeveless vest; narrow black trousers and red low-top sneakers with pale soles; tattooed slender arms, pendant. White painted face, fine red Wi-Fi/signal arcs across forehead, red eyes, fine asymmetric black circuit paint. Keep the same recognizable face and clothing in every pose.
Composition: wide 3:1 canvas, ideally 3072 x 1024. Six EQUAL invisible rectangular cells, each one sixth of width, centered at 1/12, 3/12, 5/12, 7/12, 9/12, 11/12. Leave at least 5% cell-width clear alpha margin at BOTH edges of EVERY cell. Character entirely contained in his own cell, including fists, hair and sneakers. No cell outlines. Orthographic SIDE VIEW facing RIGHT in every cell, with only slight chest visibility to preserve the tee. Same camera, silhouette proportions and pixel scale, no foreshortening and no tilted view.
Pose order strictly left to right: 1 idle ready stance arms relaxed; 2 walking contact pose left leg forward/right leg back; 3 walking opposite contact pose right leg forward/left leg back; 4 straight punch to the right, ONE lead fist extended horizontally and other fist guarding, plausible connected shoulder/elbow/wrist, no weapon; 5 compact guard with both fists in front of face; 6 jump silhouette with bent knees and arms balanced.
Registration: keep cap top and body scale consistent. For poses 1-5 set the lowest shoe sole to the same baseline at 92% canvas height. For pose 6 use the same cell anchor baseline, with the lowest shoe sole also at 92% so the GAME can lift the whole pose during the jump; bend knees by raising the other shoe, do not shrink the man. Preserve clean separation and padding for deterministic equal-cell cropping.
Style: sharp detailed hand-inked comic illustration, textured painted clothing and clean readable silhouettes, restrained amber/cyan edge highlights on the character only. No pixelation, no low-poly facets, no blurry areas.
Constraints: GENUINE transparent background with clean alpha. NO opaque color backdrop, fake checkerboard, ground shadow, platform or scenery. No separate portraits, no text labels or captions, no grid, no borders, no other characters, no extra arms or legs, no floating hands, no extra weapons, no motion streaks crossing cells, no watermark. Anatomy and hands must be plausible; six instances of the SAME slim Mac.

toolArguments.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: new penultimate Cache Back chapter-entrance painting, KEYS TO THE LINE, for an established graphic-novel game. This replaces the old ignition scene; the existing rear car-on-road painting comes next unchanged.
Input images: 1 Cache Back canonical identity/outfit; 2 EXACT yellow archive hatchback and wet night avenue setting; 3 car dashboard/cassette and street-weather continuity; 4 EXACT protected original cartridge prop, studio interior lighting and comic style.
Primary request: one wide 2.2:1 hand-inked cinematic scene of CACHE BACK looking cool, confident and determined while walking TOWARD HIS PARKED YELLOW CAR with a visible small metal CAR KEY RING held naturally in his forward hand. He is still OUTSIDE the car, full recognizable figure cap to shoes or knees, heading diagonally right toward the driver's door. His other arm securely carries the same chunky black original archive cassette with yellow hazard band from image4 at his hip; the original is never left loose on the pavement. Body weight moves into a natural stride, shoulders relaxed, eyes focused on the route. This is his own calm heading-into-action pose, not a clenched fist or walking straight toward the viewer.
Composition: low three-quarter view from street-side studio/repair-garage curb. Cache is strong foreground left-center; car occupies midground right, seen rear-left three-quarter so its closed LEFT driver door and rear hatch are visible. The car faces AWAY toward the wet avenue and skyline, matching the direction of travel in image2. Cache is approaching the left driver door, not its rear hatch or wrong side. All doors remain closed; no impossible cutaway, no person already driving. Preserve coherent real car geometry, four tires grounded, one front and rear axle, conventional single windshield, correct door handles.
EXACT car: modest boxy 1980s yellow archival hatchback, black/white diagonal side/rear stripes, circular rear emblem, black Greek-key edge trim, rectangular amber/red tail lights, dark bumper, left exhaust, yellow tow hook, a single strapped rectangular roof recorder box, and two large tape reels visible through rear hatch glass. Do not create a muscle car, supercar or extra roof devices. Roof recorder remains strapped; original cassette remains in Cache's hand until the later implied entry.
EXACT Cache: brown eyes behind CLEAR black rectangular glasses, yellow cap with two rounded short side protrusions, short dark hair, angular black lower-face mask, black mechanical neck collar with restrained cyan edges, yellow short-sleeved shirt with black Greek-key trim and established round arm emblem, dark trousers. Human proportions, no face paint, no new goggles/helmet/armor. Keys must be legible as keys and separate from fingers; plausible thumb and fingers holding the ring, not a weapon.
Setting/continuity: same wet-after-rain inhabited broadcast street, warm amber studio/shop lights at left, cyan/plum skyscraper skyline and sparse warm street lamps at right, restrained magenta road reflections. Preserve the moody night/weather and modest repair garage setting of images2-4, no daytime, no desert, no apocalypse.
Style: premium detailed black-ink comic contours, angular painted cel shading, subtle halftone/grain, crisp environmental detail, rich navy/plum shadows and yellow hero emphasis. No low-poly, no pixelation, no photo/3D, no blur, no anime redesign.
Constraints: no other identifiable characters, no duplicate Cache, no captions, dialogue, title, HUD, watermark or readable signs. Preserve established costume/car insignia only. Leave quiet upper-right space for runtime dialogue. Keep face, keys, protected cassette and car fully coherent and inside safe image margins. Opaque background.
